create.name: Mariana Caplan
create.bio:
Mariana Caplan is an American writer, teacher and psychotherapist whose work for more than twenty-five years has sat where yoga, meditation and spiritual life meet Western psychology. Her best-known books ask hard questions of the spiritual path: Halfway Up the Mountain looks at people who claim awakening too soon, The Guru Question weighs the gifts and dangers of choosing a teacher, and Eyes Wide Open is a guide to discernment for seekers. Yoga & Psyche, from Sounds True, brings yogic practice and philosophy together with body-based trauma work, and she convened a conference of the same name.

Teaching abroad since 1997, she has been on the faculty of Naropa University, Sophia University and the California Institute of Integral Studies, building graduate programmes that join psychology, yoga and meditation. Alongside a licensed clinical practice, which is not listed here, she offers spiritual guidance worldwide, which she calls spiritual friendship, and advises spiritual communities and teachers going through crisis. Her site shares a free set of recorded Yoga & Psyche practices for feeling emotion in the body and settling the nervous system. In 2023 she and her son started Soccer for World Peace, a charity that takes footballs to children in many countries.

videos.title: Discernment, Enlightenment, & Spiritual Teachers - Mariana Caplan
Yoga, Psychology, and the Wisdom of the Body - Mariana Caplan

books.title: Yoga & Psyche: Integrating the Paths of Yoga and Psychology for Healing, Transformation, and Joy
books.author: Mariana Caplan
books.description: Her Sounds True book on bringing yogic practice and philosophy into conversation with psychology, somatic work and neuroscience. It closes with a toolbox of practices for feeling emotion in the body and steadying the nervous system.

books.title: Eyes Wide Open: Cultivating Discernment on the Spiritual Path
books.author: Mariana Caplan
books.description: A guide for seekers on telling real spiritual growth from its imitations. She looks at common traps such as spiritual bypassing, misplaced trust in teachers and the pull of quick awakening, and at how to keep a clear head on the path.

books.title: The Guru Question: The Perils and Rewards of Choosing a Spiritual Teacher
books.author: Mariana Caplan
books.description: An exploration of the student and teacher bond in spiritual life. It weighs what a teacher can offer against the ways the relationship goes wrong, and asks what a student needs to bring to it.

books.title: Halfway Up the Mountain: The Error of Premature Claims to Enlightenment
books.author: Mariana Caplan
books.description: Her early study of seekers and teachers who announce full awakening before they reach it. Drawing on interviews with teachers from several traditions, it looks at why this happens and what a more honest path asks.

books.title: The Way of Failure: Winning Through Losing
books.author: Mariana Caplan
books.description: A short book on failure as a teacher rather than an enemy. She suggests that meeting loss and defeat honestly can soften pride and open a deeper kind of inner growth.

courses.title: Spiritual Guidance
courses.description: One-to-one spiritual guidance, offered worldwide online, which she describes as a form of spiritual friendship. She also advises spiritual and religious communities and teachers facing crisis.

free_resources.title: The Yoga & Psyche Method Toolbox
free_resources.description: A free workbook from her Yoga & Psyche book, with seven matching audio practices on her home page. The practices move from sensing emotion and sensation in the body to resourcing and pendulation, and can be used alone, in pairs or alongside yoga.
